title: Great Hammerhead Shark
subtitle: Cephalofoil Hydrodynamics & Serpentine Swimming Wave
description: Sphyrna mokarran pelagic elasmobranch hydrodynamics capturing the wide stereoscopic T-shaped cephalofoil head, fusiform dorsal profile, and serpentine sinusoidal swimming waves.
mathNotation: y(x, t) = A_0 \left(\frac{x}{L}\right)^{1.6} \sin\left(\omega t - \frac{2\pi x}{\lambda}\right), \quad w(x) = w_{\max} \sin\left(\frac{\pi x}{L}\right)
